clubs.description: The GRC supports international outreach initiatives within Columbia Undergraduate Admissions. The GRC is open to all students with an educational background and/or lived experience outside the United States of America.

clubs.name: Gosh Yarn It
clubs.description: Since 2012, Gosh Yarn It has grown into Columbia University’s most popular knitting and crocheting group. With charitable projects and creative events, Gosh Yarn It welcomes new knitters and crocheters of all levels.

clubs.name: Multicultural Recruitment Committee (MRC)
clubs.description: The MRC supports college access and outreach to a diverse array of prospective students in New York City and beyond within Columbia Undergraduate Admissions. The MRC is open to all students interested in supporting the mission of college access!

clubs.name: Nefesh
clubs.description: Nefesh, Columbia/Barnard Hillel’s Mental Health Awareness group seeks to create a dialogue about mental health in the Jewish community and beyond through programming on the topics of mental illness, stress, stigma, and other mental health issues.

clubs.name: Postbac Premed Student Council
clubs.description: The Postbac Premed Student Council (PPSC), which is made up of Postbac Premed and General Studies undergraduate premed students, works closely with the premedical advisors to build a supportive community.

clubs.name: Quest Scholar Network
clubs.description: The Quest Scholar Network at Columbia strives to create a space and support system for any and all low-income students attending Columbia University. Through different events, initiatives and other forms of programming, it creates a dialogue for low-income students to improve their experiences at the University.

clubs.name: Rural Recruitment Committee (RRC)
clubs.description: The RRC supports rural and small town outreach initiatives within Undergraduate Admissions and provides a community for current rural students. The RRC welcomes all students with lived experience in a rural area or small town within the United States.

clubs.name: Science Fiction Society
clubs.description: The Columbia University Science Fiction Society is an organization of students who are interested in reading fantasy and science fiction, watching movies and playing games.

clubs.name: Sign Language Club
clubs.description: CU Sign is Columbia University and Barnard College's sign language club. It hosts weekly meetings for free classes that include American Sign Language vocabulary, activities and discussions about deaf culture, all led by an ASL instructor.

clubs.name: Smash Bros. Club
clubs.description: Smash Bros. Club is devoted to playing games from the Super Smash Bros. series. It hosts events where anyone can play.

clubs.name: Sustainable Development Goals Student Hub
clubs.description: This Hub is a space for students of any college, major, or interest to engage with sustainable development in relevant terms for them. This organization is a linkage community for students from different spaces of Columbia’s network to engage in high-level discussions on pathways for youth engagement with the 17 Sustainable Development Goals. The SDG Students Hub at Columbia will facilitate an interdisciplinary framework of thinking that prepares students to address modern challenges. We are committed to act locally, translating the Global Goals into solutions for New York City.

clubs.name: Undergraduate Recruitment Committee (URC)
clubs.description: The URC is a selective organization that employs Columbia student workers to support Columbia Undergraduate Admissions outreach initiatives. The URC aims to introduce and exemplify the Columbia undergraduate experience to prospective students.

clubs.name: Activities Board at Columbia (ABC)
clubs.description: The Activities Board at Columbia has been supporting student groups at Columbia University since its inception in 1998. Through the establishment of sound fiscal policy and efficient fund distribution, ABC works to enhance the student organizational community at Columbia University.

clubs.name: Columbia College Student Council (CCSC)
clubs.description: The students of Columbia College elect the Columbia College Student Council to serve as their primary representatives, advocates and liaisons to the Columbia University community, including its administration, faculty, alumni and students, as well as to the public.

clubs.name: Engineering Student Council (ESC)
clubs.description: The Engineering Student Council strives to represent all the interests of the diverse Columbia Engineering student body and that of the University as a whole, to improve student life and to foster communication among students, faculty, administrators and alumni throughout Columbia University.

clubs.name: General Studies Student Council (GSSC)
clubs.description: The General Studies Student Council pursues academic, political, social and administrative initiatives. The group serves as a liaison between the student body and the School of General Studies administration, University offices and student organizations.

clubs.name: Multicultural Affairs Advisory Council
clubs.description:
The Multicultural Affairs Advisory Council (MAAC) is an advocacy group comprised of a broad representation of Columbia College and Columbia Engineering undergraduate students who work collectively toward continually enhancing the programs and services of Multicultural Affairs; evaluating the needs of our diverse undergraduate student population; identifying relevant campus issues; and promoting a campus environment of inclusion, self-awareness, intercultural engagement and social responsibility. MAAC is comprised of four collaborative but distinct advisory boards:

First-Gen Student Advisory Board (FAB)

International Student Advisory Board (ISAB)

Queer and Trans Student Advisory Board (QTAB)

Student of Color Advisory Board (SOCAB)

clubs.name: National Residence Hall Honorary
clubs.description: The National Residence Hall Honorary (NRHH) is a national honor society that recognizes leadership in the advancement of college and university residential communities. The King's Crown Chapter at Columbia University works to recognize excellence in residential life and to render the world a better place through community service.

clubs.name: Residence Hall Leadership Organization
clubs.description: The Residence Hall Leadership Organization (RHLO) is the campus-wide group that aims to promote community among our residential population, advocate for the needs of residents, and liaise with university administrators who directly impact the residential experience.

clubs.name: Student Governing Board (SGB)
clubs.description: The Student Governing Board at Columbia University and Barnard College is the only governing board including student groups from all four undergraduate schools.

clubs.name: Student Health Advisory Committee
clubs.description: The Student Health Advisory Committee acts as a liaison between the Columbia student body and the six departments and offices of Columbia Health: Alice! Health Promotion; Counseling and Psychological Services; Disability Services; Insurance and Immunization Compliance; Medical Services and Gay Health Advocacy Project; and Sexual Violence Response.

clubs.name: Barnard Alliance for Healthcare Humanitarian Aid
